name: intros-agency
description: An agency call opens with introductions; two of the names aren't on the invite.
lines: Hi everyone, I'm Rochelle from the agency, I'll be running the session today.
And I'm Ola, I look after the media plan on the agency side.
Lee here, from the client side, thanks for setting this up.
Hi all, I'm Imogen, I lead the product team.
Great. So the plan for today is to walk through the campaign timeline and agree the budget split.
I've put the draft media plan in the shared folder, it's the version from Tuesday.
We had a look, the main question from our side is whether we can move some spend into video.
Ola, can you talk us through the video options?
Sure. There are two routes, a short pre-roll package or a sponsored series, and the pre-roll is cheaper to test.
